items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Johnny Hartman? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Not well, but yes I did.

ctx.x: can find them nowadays, and I’m sure you can. I thought Wynton was incredible on The Shadow of Your Smile. How beautiful. That really was something. And what about Johnny Mandel? Unbelievable. I knew him when he was with the Basie band. We used to call him Johnny MAN-dul. Lovely man. What a heart. What ears. Boy.
Yes. Not well, but yes I did.
